about_the_game:
BONK WITH YOUR FRIENDS!

MeGa BoNKeRS ToGeTHeR is a chaotic co-op action roguelike where you and your friends smash, punch, and bonk your way through waves of bizarre enemies and ridiculous bosses. Every run is different, every encounter is unpredictable, and every bonk is louder than the last!

TEAM UP OR GET WRECKED

  • Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op

  • Fight through randomized maps full of goofy but deadly creatures

  • Collect absurd loot and build over-the-top combos

  • Survive as long as you can... or watch your friends blame you for the wipe

POPULAR CHARACTERS

🥊 Punch of Eternity (PoE)

A fist that echoes through time. Every punch is devastating, every fight an eternal challenge.

🃏 Trickster Laugh Inc. (TLI)

Mad laughter, deadly surprises! Throws random cards, each with a different chaotic effect. No battle ever plays out the same.

😈 Lucid Enigma (LE)

The detective of dark secrets. Outsmarts and outguns enemies, hunting them down with mysterious power.

🦍 Dark4rest (D4)

It all starts with a banana and ends in chaos. Harnesses the raw power of nature to crush enemies with brute force.

BONK, UPGRADE, REPEAT

  • Stack ridiculous upgrades and watch your character spiral into chaos

  • One run you’re swinging frying pans like a tornado, the next you’re exploding into fireworks every time you jump

  • No two bonks are ever the same — embrace the madness!

FEATURES

  • Bonk-ready characters with unique skills and styles

  • Items that combine into outrageous synergies

  • Seasonal bosses & events to keep the chaos fresh

  • Endless equipment combinations in HardCore Mode

  • No two runs are the same — procedural madness guaranteed

"We started with one bonk… now it’s a lifestyle. I'm crying like 'Bonk Bonk Bonk'. 10/10, would bonk again." — Definitely Not a Developer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 560 (≥ 2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable connection

short_description: Team up with 1–4 friends and dive into wild co-op battles! Smash waves of goofy enemies, grab ridiculous loot, and grow insanely powerful together. Every run’s a new kind of chaos!
